partners.mechanism_chain: PRKAG2 (HGNC:9600) —LEADS_TO→ Wolff-Parkinson-White syndrome (MONDO:0008685); TSC1 (HGNC:11771) —DISRUPTS→ mTOR signaling pathway (GO:0031926); TSC2 (HGNC:11772) —DISRUPTS→ mTOR signaling pathway (GO:0031926); mTOR signaling pathway (GO:0031926) —LEADS_TO→ Lymphangioleiomyomatosis (MONDO:0011705).
